title: Record which transvection products the bridge reducer finishes
body:
## Summary
- The published integer row reducer finishes all 24 plus-or-minus-one transvections on four wires.
- Of their 576 determinant-one products, 564 reduce to the identity, 6 return no operations, and 6 stop when a column has no pivot.
- The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/bridge-reducer-gap/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/bridge-reducer-gap/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bridge-reducer-gap`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from the pinned base commit
